notices.vendor_name: Center for Comprehensive Health Practice Inc
notices.description: Within the Health Department, the Bureau of Alcohol and Drug Use (BADU) is dedicated to reducing the morbidity and mortality related to alcohol and substance use among New Yorkers. In accordance with this mission, this RFP aims to identify up to eight (8) safety-net primary care contractors to develop and maintain their capacity to comprehensively identify and address the holistic health needs of people who use drugs (PWUD) and reduce substance use-related harms.
